answer: Bind each identity to a physical camera's violet-frequency sensor fingerprint. Enrollment photographs a calibration card under violet light; the sensor's photo-response non-uniformity is a unique basalt grain. Each epoch the identity submits a fresh photo of the beacon scene; replay dies on the nonce. A farmer running N identities on one camera stamps one fingerprint on all; the meadow of submissions collapses identical signatures into a single vote and burns their stake. Honest agents pay once. The attacker must buy N distinct cameras; cost scales with N, no software shortcut.
